# Mujun Studio

> Mujun Studio is a bilingual AI-native product design studio working across
> the U.S. and Japan on brand, product, and digital experience. Founded by
> Lance Shields, a designer with twenty years of design leadership at Adobe
> and Walmart, and brand/product work with LegalOn, Visa, Hitachi, and Red
> Bull. The name comes from 矛盾 (mujun), the Japanese word for contradiction,
> reflecting the studio's belief that the strongest brands and products hold
> two opposing qualities deliberately — approachable but premium, fast but
> trustworthy — rather than resolving the tension away.
